headline: Loss narrows sharply both q/q and y/y
summary_short: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera reported a Q2 FY2026 EPS loss of Rp16, narrowing 59.0% q/q from a Rp39 loss and 85.6% y/y from a Rp111 loss.
summary_long: EPS loss narrowed to Rp16 per share from a Rp39 loss last quarter and a Rp111 loss a year earlier — improvements of 59.0% q/q and 85.6% y/y. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
